verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.mx.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index (e.g., 'Products (152 pages)') pointing to markdown versions of doc pages. Many cited docs URLs are served as clean .md files, which agents can ingest directly. MX also documents an official MCP server at docs.mx.com/mcp, adding another agent-oriented entry point. Missing for 10: first-party docs explaining how to use llms.txt or the markdown docs with agents (e.g., an llms-full.txt or an AI-usage guide), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming the docs effectively.
